'''Soul kindling''' is a variant of [[kindling]] made with soul sand or soul soil. It replaces the {{MCW|Soul Campfire|soul campfire}} and cooks exactly the same recipes as kindling.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Soul kindling is crafted from a kindling and any soul fire base block (soul sand or soul soil), and comes out unlit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/soul_campfire.json}}</ref> The vanilla soul campfire recipe is removed.

=== Breaking ===
Soul kindling always drops itself, unlit.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/soul_campfire.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Soul kindling cooks all of kindling's recipes at the same speed. See [[Kindling#Cooking]] and [[Cooking]].
